blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Save Bangsamoro Movement returned to the Supreme Court on Monday with a rally to press its opposition to several provisions of the Bangsamoro Autonomy Act (BAA) No. 86, the law that created the parliamentary districts of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). In a statement, Datu Toks Abdulrahman, spokesperson of the Save Bangsamoro Movement, urged the high tribunal to closely examine the law and the configuration of the districts it drew, particularly those the group questions on grounds of territorial makeup and geographic contiguity.
